name: Snackbar
description: A framework-free Web Component that reports what just happened through persistent live regions, queues messages one at a time, and never puts a time limit on one you can act on.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Plain messages summoned in code, leaving focus exactly where it was.

variants.name: Severity
variants.description: All four levels, with information and success waiting their turn while warning and error interrupt.

variants.name: Action
variants.description: Messages offering an action, which run no timer because a button that expires cannot be reached in time.

variants.name: Placement
variants.description: The six anchors, named by logical edge so they follow the writing direction.

variants.name: Queue
variants.description: Several messages arriving together and shown one at a time, in the order they were raised.

variants.name: Timing
variants.description: How long a message stays, and how hover, focus, and a hidden tab each stop the clock.
